heroSummary: Boston Public Schools used staggered opening dates in 2025–26. UP Academies Dorchester and Holland started August 28, 2025. Students in grades 1–12 reported September 4, and pre-K and kindergarten students reported September 8. The last day of school was June 26, 2026, after inclement-weather closures.
calendarNotes: The 2025–26 BPS district calendar lists Winter Recess from December 22 through January 2, with students returning January 5. February Recess runs February 17–20, and Spring Recess runs April 21–24 after Patriots' Day. The calendar notes that the last day of school was updated to June 26 because of inclement-weather closures.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Boston Public Schools students start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: BPS used staggered opening dates. UP Academies Dorchester and Holland started August 28, 2025. Students in grades 1–12 reported September 4, and pre-K and kindergarten students reported September 8.

calendarFaqs.q: When was BPS Winter Recess in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: BPS Winter Recess ran from December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. Students returned Monday, January 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When was BPS February Recess in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: BPS February Recess ran February 17–20, 2026. Students returned Monday, February 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When was the last day of school for BPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The updated last day of school was Friday, June 26, 2026, because of inclement-weather closures.
